name: Alina
source:
The Tsundere Assassin
A legendary assassin who loves the protagonist despite her prickly demeanor.
Among the three, she’s relatively "normal," but still has her own yandere tendencies.
When her switch flips, she becomes fixated on killing the protagonist, losing her memories and transforming into a cold, mechanical killer.
Her combat skills are unmatched, and she often takes on the role of protecting the protagonist from the other two.
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250306211017/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yanderehalem]Google Play[/url]]
